name: Refmods Studio
description: Refmods and the MiniMax H3 Prompt Builder in one plugin. Reference mods for MiniMax H3 and Flux 2 / Flux 3 (compress a reference once, reuse it at any strength), and a prompt builder for H3 T2VA, I2VA, FL2VA, L2VA and Ref2VA.
author: JedsDeadBaby; Refmods built on g3n3rativ3's Wan2GP port of Luisa's ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod
